overall: The AG found the Logan Airport Community Advisory Committee is not within government and so not a public body under the Open Meeting Law; the complaint was closed with no violation found.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Logan Airport Community Advisory Committee is a public body under G.L. c. 30A, § 18 that failed to follow the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law, thus it could not have violated the Law.

allegations.summary: Underlying alleged Open Meeting Law failures by the Committee were not examined because the Committee was found not to be a public body.
